To: Operations Leadership, Sales, Finance
From: Supply Chain Director
Date: [Insert Date]
Subject: Shipping plan to reduce freight spend and meet demand across our network

Situation
We are moving product from multiple warehouses and plants to a wide set of stores and customers. Transportation spend is a significant cost driver, and on-time, in-full delivery is central to our customer commitments. Recent shifts in inventory positions and lane rates mean our historical shipping patterns may no longer be the most cost-effective.

Problem
Each source location has limited available inventory or throughput, while every destination has a required quantity that must be fulfilled. Shipping costs vary by route. We need a clear, data-driven plan that determines how much to ship from each source to each destination so that all needs are met without exceeding available supply. Partial shipments are allowed, so we can split quantities across routes when that reduces cost or improves service.

Goal
Create a shipping plan that:
- Meets the required quantity at every destination
- Does not exceed available inventory at any source
- Keeps total freight spend as low as possible by using lower-cost routes where feasible
- Specifies shipment quantities by route, allowing partial shipments when economical

Once the attached data is confirmed, we will produce a recommended flow plan and projected freight spend for review, along with scenario views that reflect potential rate or supply changes.
